• (01:46) - OpenAI Uncovers Spy Device
  • (08:41) - Are Your Devices Listening to You?
  • (20:13) - Apple x LG
  • (24:59) - Home Devices Tier List

  • (40:46) - Inside The World of GTA 6
  • (43:38) - Kelly Clarkson's Bird Store Drama
  • (52:27) - Thomas Neckel discusses co-founding Fragment, a New York fintech company building financial infrastructure designed for AI agents. He explains how Fragment translates contractual rules into deterministic financial workflows, enabling agents to automate complex processes such as payments, refunds, accounting, and insurance claims while preventing costly errors.
  • (01:02:17) - Kabir Jain discusses his role as Erewhon’s Chief Growth Officer, overseeing technology, e-commerce, data, membership, and other growth initiatives beyond opening stores. He explains Erewhon’s disciplined expansion strategy, commissary-based operating model, influence on emerging consumer brands, celebrity collaborations, and focus on delivering a premium customer experience.
  • (01:22:02) - Danielle Axman discusses founding Wilder Market, a premium neighborhood grocery concept opening in Midtown Miami, inspired by her search for thoughtfully sourced, high-quality food for her family. She highlights the market’s expert-developed product standards, Michelin-star culinary partnership, hospitality-focused experience, and potential expansion across South Florida and the Southeast.
  • (01:30:45) - John Urschel, an MIT assistant professor of mathematics and former professional football player, discusses how AI is transforming mathematical research, education, and problem-solving. He argues that human understanding and creativity remain essential, predicts that mathematics will expand rather than be “solved,” and considers AI’s potential to improve football analytics.
  • (01:44:48) - Nicholas Sharp discusses Attio’s new hybrid architecture for agentic revenue, which lets AI agents work with customer data while maintaining governance and security guardrails. The Attio co-founder and CEO also highlights how leading sales teams use AI for highly personalized customer experiences, his excitement about decision models, and Attio’s extensive use of its own products.
  • (01:55:50) - Jason Ballard, co-founder and CEO of construction technology company ICON, discusses its $200 million Series D and mission to address the housing crisis using robotic 3D printing. He explains ICON’s cost-saving construction system, expansion into licensing its technology to builders, and work with NASA to develop lunar infrastructure using local materials.
  • (02:05:41) - Erik Bernhardsson, co-founder and CEO of Modal, discusses the company’s rapid growth and its platform for simplifying AI infrastructure across numerous cloud providers. He highlights soaring demand for inference, training, and sandbox tools, along with opportunities in low-latency applications, alternative chips, and broader enterprise adoption.
  • (02:14:59) - Josh Tyrangiel discusses how Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos are racing to vertically integrate the space economy through reusable rockets, satellite networks, orbital data centers, and AI. Drawing on his experience covering business and technology, he explains SpaceX’s commanding lead, Blue Origin’s efforts to catch up, and Bezos’s long-standing ambition to make space infrastructure central to Amazon, robotics, and advanced AI.
  • (02:31:03) - Aida Baradari, founder of Dvalence, discusses Spectre, a device designed to prevent microphones from making unauthorized audio recordings. Baradari explains its privacy-focused technology, planned enterprise applications, current pricing and size, and the company’s efforts to launch and improve the product.
